figurative_meaning_en: One who unnecessarily bares or shows teeth in a lewd manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মেয়েটির দিকে দাঁত-ক্যালানে তাকিয়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is staring at the girl with a leering grin.
note: This idiom carries a strong connotation of indecency and is used to describe inappropriate behavior.
